      device_id = db.update_device_notes(conn, body.device_id, notes)
      return jsonify({"status": "ok", "device_id": device_id})
+ 
+ 
+ @api_v1.route("/debug/db_devices")
+ @with_db_connection
+ def debug_db_devices(conn):
+     """Get all devices from database for debug page"""
+     import json
+     try:
+         device_data = db.get_device_status(conn)
+         device_names = [dev.get("device_name", "Unknown") for dev in device_data]
+         return jsonify({
+             "names": device_names,
+             "data": device_data
+         })
+     except Exception as e:
+         logger.warning("Failed to fetch all devices: %s", e)
+         return jsonify({"error": str(e)}), 500
+ 
+ 
+ @api_v1.route("/debug/hubitat_devices")
+ def debug_hubitat_devices():
+     """Get all Hubitat devices for debug page"""
+     import json
+     from . import hubitat
+     try:
+         hubitat_devices = hubitat.get_all_devices()
+         device_names = [dev.get("name", "Unknown") for dev in hubitat_devices]
+         return jsonify({
+             "names": device_names,
+             "data": hubitat_devices
+         })
+     except Exception as e:
+         logger.warning("Failed to fetch Hubitat devices: %s", e)
+         return jsonify({"error": str(e)}), 500
+ 
+ 
+ @api_v1.route("/debug/ae200_devices")
+ def debug_ae200_devices():
+     """Get all AE-200 devices for debug page"""
+     import json
+     import asyncio
+     from . import ae200
+     try:
+         ae200_devices = ae200.get_devices()
+         device_names = [dev.get("name", "Unknown") for dev in ae200_devices]
+         
+         # Per-device status direct from AE-200, fetched concurrently
+         async def _fetch_ae200_details_async(devices):
+             ae200_details = {}
+             tasks = []
+             ids = []
+             for dev in devices:
+                 device_id = dev.get("id")
+                 if device_id is None:
+                     continue
+                 ids.append(str(device_id))
+                 tasks.append(ae200.get_device_info_async(device_id))
+             if not tasks:
+                 return ae200_details
+             results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
+             for key, result in zip(ids, results):
+                 if isinstance(result, Exception):
+                     ae200_details[key] = {"error": str(result)}
+                 else:
+                     ae200_details[key] = result
+             return ae200_details
+ 
+         ae200_details = ae200.runner.run_async_safely(
+             _fetch_ae200_details_async(ae200_devices)
+         )
+         
+         return jsonify({
+             "names": device_names,
+             "devices": ae200_devices,
+             "details": ae200_details
+         })
+     except Exception as e:
+         logger.warning("Failed to fetch AE-200 devices: %s", e)
+         return jsonify({"error": str(e)}), 500
  
```

+                 document.getElementById('hubitat-names-loading').style.display = 'none';
+                 document.getElementById('hubitat-names-pre').textContent = JSON.stringify(data.names, null, 2);
+                 document.getElementById('hubitat-names-pre').style.display = 'block';
+                 
+                 document.getElementById('hubitat-data-loading').style.display = 'none';
+                 document.getElementById('hubitat-data-pre').textContent = JSON.stringify(data.data, null, 2);
+                 document.getElementById('hubitat-data-pre').style.display = 'block';
+             }
+         })
+         .catch(error =&gt; {
+             document.getElementById('hubitat-names-loading').textContent = 'Error loading data: ' + error.message;
+             document.getElementById('hubitat-data-loading').textContent = 'Error loading data: ' + error.message;
+         });
+ 
+     // Load AE-200 devices
+     fetch('/api/v1/debug/ae200_devices')
+         .then(response =&gt; response.json())
+         .then(data =&gt; {
+             if (data.error) {
+                 document.getElementById('ae200-names-loading').textContent = 'Error: ' + data.error;
+                 document.getElementById('ae200-devices-loading').textContent = 'Error: ' + data.error;
+                 document.getElementById('ae200-details-loading').textContent = 'Error: ' + data.error;
+             } else {
+                 document.getElementById('ae200-names-loading').style.display = 'none';
+                 document.getElementById('ae200-names-pre').textContent = JSON.stringify(data.names, null, 2);
+                 document.getElementById('ae200-names-pre').style.display = 'block';
+                 
+                 document.getElementById('ae200-devices-loading').style.display = 'none';
+                 document.getElementById('ae200-devices-pre').textContent = JSON.stringify(data.devices, null, 2);
+                 document.getElementById('ae200-devices-pre').style.display = 'block';
+                 
+                 document.getElementById('ae200-details-loading').style.display = 'none';
+                 document.getElementById('ae200-details-pre').textContent = JSON.stringify(data.details, null, 2);
+                 document.getElementById('ae200-details-pre').style.display = 'block';
+             }
+         })
+         .catch(error =&gt; {
+             document.getElementById('ae200-names-loading').textContent = 'Error loading data: ' + error.message;
+             document.getElementById('ae200-devices-loading').textContent = 'Error loading data: ' + error.message;
+             document.getElementById('ae200-details-loading').textContent = 'Error loading data: ' + error.message;
+         });
+ });
+ &lt;/script&gt;
  {% endblock %}
  
```

</details>

</tool-use>
